Committee: Boards, Agencies and Commissions
Sponsor: Sanderford
Analyst: Robin Rawls
Date: 02/17/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 45 as introduced provides for the continuance of the State Board of Medical Examiners and Medical Licensure Commission until October 1, 2025 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise affect state or federal funding.
Howard Sanderford, Chair
Boards, Agencies and Commissions

Date: 02/25/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 45 as passed the House of Representatives provides for the continuance of the State Board of Medical Examiners and Medical Licensure Commission until October 1, 2025. Pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise affect state or federal funding.
Steve Livingston, Chairperson
Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development

Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
Sponsor: McMillan
Analyst: Bryan Young
Date: 03/09/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 235 as passed the House of Representatives would increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama Department of Health to adopt rules to implement the provisions of this bill and to add the new requirements to the list of items that inspectors must verify during a restaurant inspection.
Steve Livingston, Chairperson
Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
